title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5 reanalysis)
summary: Daily maximum temperature (temperature_2m_max) from Open-Meteo's Historical Weather API, which uses ERA5 and ERA5-Land reanalysis from Copernicus ECMWF. Data is available from 1940 to near-realtime at 0.25° to 0.1° resolution, and from 2017 also with ECMWF IFS at 9 km resolution. The API delivers gap-free daily aggregates for any GPS coordinate. Probes for Milan (45.4642°N, 9.1900°E) for both the history window (June 2023) and recent window (June 2025) returned full daily max/min temperatures in °C. The free tier is for non-commercial evaluation only; commercial use (Valdena Gelato Shop) requires a paid subscription. The data is licensed under CC BY 4.0 with attribution required.

fields.name: daily.temperature_2m_max
fields.description: Daily maximum temperature at 2 metres above ground

fields.name: daily.temperature_2m_min
fields.description: Daily minimum temperature at 2 metres above ground

schema.notes: Only daily.temperature_2m_max is mandatory for N3. All requested daily variables return simultaneously. Latitude/longitude of the shop is required.

temporal.refresh_cadence: static for historical reanalysis (ERA5 periodically extended)

spatial.notes: Grid-interpolated (ERA5 0.25° ~28 km, ERA5-Land 0.1° ~11 km, IFS from 2017 at 9 km). Nearest grid cell to the shop coordinates is used.

licence.name: CC BY 4.0
licence.agreement_status: not_required_open_data (free tier non-commercial); commercial use needs paid subscription
licence.evidence: probe_url https://open-meteo.com/en/licence: 'API data are offered under Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)'. probe_url https://open-meteo.com/en/pricing: 'Commercial Use Licence - A subscription grants a commercial use licence'.

access.request_process: Free tier: no API key, non-commercial only. Commercial: subscribe at https://open-meteo.com/en/pricing (Standard/Professional/Enterprise) for API key and dedicated endpoint customer-api.open-meteo.com.

documentation_excerpts: Gap-free and consistent historical weather data using weather reanalysis from ERA5 (0.25°, from 1940) and ERA5-Land (0.1°, from 1950) and ECMWF IFS (9 km, from 2017).
Commercial Use Licence: A subscription grants a commercial use licence and an API key for the dedicated customer endpoint at customer-api.open-meteo.com.
Attribution: You must give appropriate credit, provide a link to the licence, and indicate if changes were made.
Non-Commercial Use: By using the Free API for non-commercial use you agree... less than 10,000 API calls per day, 5,000 per hour and 600 per minute.
quality_notes: ERA5 reanalysis is a grid-interpolated model, not a local ground station — actual temperatures at the shop location may differ from the nearest grid cell (up to 28 km on ERA5, ~11 km on ERA5-Land, 9 km on IFS).
Free tier is non-commercial only; Valdena Gelato Shop (commercial entity) requires a paid subscription. Register lists as approved for production, implying subscription is obtainable.
Data provided as-is with no warranty (see terms: 'Open-Meteo assumes no responsibility for any inaccuracies').
Hourly and daily variables can be requested together in one call. Daily temperature_2m_max is directly available.

provenance.claim: The API covers both required windows (1940 to near-realtime)
